content: Donghan Kim (Donghan) is a Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, and Forward Deployment Engineer focused on dependable systems and applied ML. He works across low-level C/C++ systems, Python and TypeScript services, model training and evaluation, retrieval workflows, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud deployment. He is completing the AI/Data branch at 42 Paris (RNCP Level 7).

Donghan's current focus areas: (1) software engineering — systems, APIs, networking, and reliable service design; (2) machine learning — model fundamentals, signal preprocessing, evaluation, and retrieval; (3) forward deployment — integration, cloud infrastructure, Docker, Kubernetes, and operating systems in real environments.

Donghan is open to Software Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, and Forward Deployment Engineering opportunities. He is based in Paris and is open to opportunities in Paris, Europe, or remote-friendly teams.
Beyond code, Donghan's interests include philosophy, relativity, robotics, and AI. He is drawn to roles where rigorous engineering and careful model work meet real data.
Donghan Kim's GitHub is https://github.com/Donghan5. His LinkedIn is https://www.linkedin.com/in/donghan-kim01. His email is donghank@student.42.fr.
Donghan Kim's tech stack includes: C, C++, Python, Go, TypeScript, React, Bash, Linux, Docker, Git, TailwindCSS, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Kafka, Redis, Nest.js, Node.js, and Socket.io.
Donghan Kim is proficient in systems programming languages (C, C++) and modern application languages (Python, Go, TypeScript). He has strong experience with both low-level and high-level programming.

Donghan Kim has DevOps skills including Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, Nginx configuration, Linux system administration, and automated infrastructure provisioning with Ansible on cloud platforms (Scaleway).
Donghan Kim has AI/ML skills including Machine Learning, Deep Learning, linear regression, multilayer perceptrons (neural networks), and is working towards implementing Transformers from scratch.

Donghan Kim is currently a CS student at 42 Paris (2024 - Present), pursuing RNCP Level 7 (Master's equivalent) in the System, Network, Cybersecurity & OS track. He developed foundational skills through project-based learning, including low-level programming in C/C++, system administration (Born2beRoot), deploying containerized applications with Docker (Inception), and automated cloud infrastructure provisioning with Ansible (cloud-1).

Donghan Kim served as a Sergeant in the Republic of Korea Army (2020 - 2022). He was responsible for training and leading a team of soldiers in the field, maintaining equipment and facilities, and ensuring safety and security. He participated in demining operations.

Donghan Kim's selected case studies are Portfolio RAG Chat (ML system, retrieval, deployment), Multilayer Perceptron (model fundamentals, NumPy, backpropagation), and Total Perspective Vortex (applied ML, EEG signal classification). Other projects include cloud-1, chatapp, E-commerce API, Weather app, weather_api, ft_transcendence, ft_linear_regression, miniRT, webserv, minishell, Philosophers, Inception, and more.

Portfolio RAG Chat: A live portfolio with an AI chat layer. Verified architecture from the repository: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, and React Router on Vercel; FastAPI Python 3.11 backend in Docker on Render; POST /api/chat endpoint; FastEmbed ONNX BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings; Supabase pgvector top-5 similarity retrieval through match_documents RPC; Groq Llama 3 70B generation; CORS-scoped frontend origins. Live URL verified with Vercel response at https://www.donghank.website/. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/portfolio_RAG

cloud-1: A cloud infrastructure automation project completed at 42 Paris. Deployed and managed a scalable multi-service web infrastructure on Scaleway cloud using Ansible for fully automated provisioning and configuration management. The infrastructure includes Nginx configured as a reverse proxy, a WordPress CMS, and a MariaDB database — all provisioned from scratch via Ansible playbooks following infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices. The project also covers SSL/TLS certificate management and secure remote access configuration. Demonstrates end-to-end DevOps workflow: from bare cloud VMs to a production-ready web stack, with repeatable, version-controlled deployment automation. Tech stack: Ansible, Nginx, WordPress, MariaDB, Scaleway, DevOps, IaC, Cloud, SSL. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/cloud-1

cloud-1 technical details: The project uses Ansible inventory and playbooks to provision multiple cloud VMs on Scaleway. Key tasks include installing and configuring Nginx as a reverse proxy, deploying WordPress with PHP-FPM, setting up MariaDB with secure credentials, managing firewall rules (UFW), automating SSL certificate renewal, and ensuring idempotent configuration across servers. The architecture follows a separation of concerns: web/proxy tier (Nginx) and application/database tier. This mirrors real-world DevOps practices for reproducible cloud deployments.

Weather app: A weather application built with React and TypeScript, using the OpenWeatherMap API to fetch real-time weather data. Features include current weather, 5-day forecast, and search functionality for specific locations. Tech stack: React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, OpenWeatherMap API. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/weather_app

E-commerce API: A RESTful API for an e-commerce platform built with Typescript and Go using the Gin framework. Features include user authentication, product management, order processing, and payment integration. Uses PostgreSQL for data storage and Docker for containerization. Tech stack: Go, TypeScript (nest.js), PostgreSQL, Docker. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/ecommerce_api

weather_api: A weather API service that provides current weather data and forecasts. Implements 2 servers with Go and Typescript (Nest.js), using Redis for caching. Tech stack: Go, Typescript (nest.js), Redis. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/weather_api

chatapp: A full-stack chat application with real-time messaging, user authentication, and group chats. Deployed using Kubernetes with a CI/CD pipeline. Tech stack: React, Typescript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Kafka, K8s. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/chatapp

ft_linear_regression: Implemented basic linear regression from scratch using Python and Numpy. This is a machine learning project from 42 Paris. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/ft_linear_regression

multilayer-perceptron: A Multilayer Perceptron from scratch using Python, NumPy, and pandas. The repository presents this as model-fundamentals evidence: fully connected layers, forward propagation, backward propagation, softmax, cross-entropy, mini-batch training, train-only standardization, early stopping, SGD, Adam, model serialization, and tests for activation derivatives, gradient correctness, optimizer behavior, IO, numerical stability, and end-to-end training. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/multilayer_perceptron

Total Perspective Vortex: Applied ML / EEG Signal Classification project. Verified claims from the repository: processes EEG data from PhysioNet; parses and filters EDF signals; standardizes channels and montage; renames annotations for hands / feet classes; applies average reference projection; applies 7-30 Hz band filtering; extracts epochs and crops learning segments; constructs X feature matrix and y label array. The stated goals target dimensionality reduction, scikit-learn pipeline usage, and real-time stream classification. The repository does not verify metrics, live inference results, classifier validation, or experimental conclusions. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/total-perspective-vortex

learning_kafka: Understanding of Kafka concepts and data-pipeline through hands-on projects, with a goal of understanding fundamental principles. Tech stack: Kafka, Data Engineering, Python. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/learning_kafka

Understanding of ML: Understanding of Machine Learning concepts and algorithms through hands-on projects, with a goal of implementing Transformers. Tech stack: Python, C++, C, ML. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/Understanding_of_ML
libasm: A low-level programming library written in Assembly, focusing on Unix system calls and interfacing. Tech stack: Assembly, Low-Level. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/libasm

ft_transcendence: Developed a full-stack web application featuring real-time multiplayer Pong, chat, and user profiles. Tech stack: TypeScript, Full-Stack, Web App. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/ft_transcendence

Inception: Set up a multi-container infrastructure using Docker and docker-compose, including services like Nginx, WordPress, and MariaDB. This project demonstrates Docker and system administration skills. Tech stack: Docker, System Admin, Nginx. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/inception

webserv: Developed a simple HTTP server in C++ that handles GET and POST requests, demonstrating understanding of web protocols and networking. Tech stack: C++, Networking, HTTP. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/webserv
CPP Modules: Completed a series of C++ modules (00-09) to master object-oriented programming concepts and practices at 42 Paris. Tech stack: C++, OOP. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/CPP_Modules

miniRT: Implemented a ray tracing engine in C to render 3D scenes with various geometric objects and lighting effects. This project demonstrates graphics programming. Tech stack: C, Graphics, Ray Tracing. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/miniRT

minishell: Developed a simple UNIX shell implementation with command parsing, execution, and basic job control features. Tech stack: C, System Programming, Shell. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/minishell

Philosophers: Solved the dining philosophers problem using C threads and mutexes to prevent deadlocks and ensure fair resource access. Tech stack: C, Multithreading, Concurrency. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/philosopher

push_swap: Created an efficient algorithm to sort a stack of numbers with limited operations, optimizing for the fewest moves. Tech stack: C, Algorithm, Sorting. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/push_swap
ft_printf: Implemented a custom printf function in C to handle formatted output with variable argument lists. Tech stack: C, Library, Formatting. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/ft_printf

get_next_line: Implemented a function to read a line from a file descriptor, handling multiple files and dynamic memory allocation. Tech stack: C, File I/O, Buffering. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/get_next_line
Libft: Developed a custom C library with essential functions to enhance programming efficiency and code reusability. Tech stack: C, Library, Utilities. GitHub: https://github.com/Donghan5/Libft
